host_compilation: C89, pedantic-errors, Wall, Wextra, Werror, AddressSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer
leak_sanitizer: Disabled because the executor ptrace prevents it; no candidate or harness allocates heap memory. Address/UB checks remain enabled and halt on errors.
checks: live current identifier mutation after lookup
payload +8 or +12 and live unsigned parameter at +10
live signed count decrement before calls
live subsequent offset/type/id changes across callbacks
optional final id callback and return status
bounds: Allocated aligned resource/list buffers, terminators, valid enabled positive stack counts and in-range offsets are required. Host group-header offsets are pointer-free and checked; pointer-table stride is native 32-bit evidence, not host layout. Synthetic external contracts do not reconstruct the helper algorithms. No malformed resource/game/ROM proof.
